changes: First release: a second layer on a MIDI track's AMP page, CC Receive (2/2), sets the incoming CC number for each of VAL1-VAL8 on the track's own channel; every slot starts at the stock 70-77. Four jsr sites: the per-track incoming-CC handler's entry (0x400d6c80), the parameter read (0x4000fe10) and write (0x40010b62) the pages use, and the parameter pages' title copy (0x40030954).

Source-only export compiled in the pinned GCC 16.2 Docker toolchain; linked with Core 2.1 it reproduces the three emulator-tested SysEx files byte for byte (alone, with FX Track, with dt-support and CC Assignment Names).
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
